title: 第19章 我很出名第20章 天雷藤消息
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天虽然偶然会有些危险，但越是面对危险，心就越是平静。
虽说这两锻骨境高阶的落星宗弟子，围攻他，可对他来说，又何尝不是一种磨练？
锻骨境级别的妖兽，本身确实是强大，可论灵活性，定然不如人类。
再过一些日子，唐天就要与林逸尘一战，今天与落星宗弟子一战，正是检验一下自己，与锻骨境高阶的修者，差距还有多少。
不过就从刚才交手来看，唐天一旦修成了九转天雷诀，瞬间提升到焚血境高阶的话，战斗力也会提升好几倍。
到时候再与身为内门弟子的林逸尘一战，也会十拿九稳。
两名落星宗弟子哪里知晓唐天心里如何想，他们心急火燎的想将这小子斩杀，好去帮忙对付叶如雪。
唐天虽说只能施展肉身的力量，却并不好对付，尤其是近身战，爆发力简直恐怖无比。
他们虽说修为强大，可肉身却很脆弱，稍有不慎，怕是会被唐天一拳给打爆了。
就在此时，林间响起一声惨叫。
原来是那瘦高青年，久守必失，已经被叶如雪手中的长剑贯穿了胸口。
“不好，师兄已经死了，我们快走！”
原本围攻唐天的两人，吓得魂不附体。
开什么玩笑，一对一的话，就只有他们死的份了。
“现在才想走？晚了！”
唐天冷笑一声，趁着其中一人心慌意乱，瞬间近身，一拳轰出。
一拳便将此人的胸口肋骨，打断了数根。
唐天抢过对方手中长剑，顺势一冲而过，剑刃抹过对方的脖子。
尸体倒下，只剩下另一人想要逃跑却腿发软的男子。
唐天站在他的前面，叶如雪则是站在其身后，压迫力实在是太大了。
虽说叶如雪实力强大，可唐天给对方的压力，反而更大。
实在是唐天出手狠辣，下手太过凶残，已经给那名落星宗弟子留下了抹不去的阴影。
“噗通”
一声，那名男子一把跪倒在地上，颤颤巍巍的说道：“还请二位……二位饶我一命。
今天所发生的一切，我也定然会守口如瓶……我……”
“不好意思，本少爷不喜欢听废话！”
唐天手中的长剑，如同一道闪电般，刺进了对方的胸口。
到死的时候，这名落星宗的弟子才发现，众人都低估了唐天。
唐天不仅猥琐，还很狂，下手狠辣不留情……
早知道会有这个下场，他们无论如何都不会愿意去招惹一个焚血境初阶的修者。
可话说回来了，换了任何一个锻骨境高阶的修者，又怎么会将一个焚血境初阶的修者放在眼里？
就是焚血境高阶在他们眼里，都只是蝼蚁而已。
唐天抬头看去，正好见到叶如雪看着自己。
被这么一个绝色佳人看着，唐天都有些不好意思，难道是自己太帅了吗？
完全忘记现在衣衫褴褛的乞丐模样，又怎么能和帅这个字扯上边？
唐天没有开口，叶如雪却主动开口说话，行了一礼道：“多谢这位公子相救。”
可以说方才五个人，有四个都是死在了唐天手上，不得不说，这一次英雄救美很成功。
content_en:
Although Tang Tian was occasionally in danger, the more he faced danger, the calmer he became.
Although these two high-level Falling Star Sect disciples in the Bone Forging Realm besieged him, it was not a kind of training for him.
The bone-forging level monsters themselves are indeed powerful, but in terms of flexibility, they are definitely not as good as humans.
In a few days, Tang Tian will have a battle with Lin Yichen. Today's battle with the disciples of the Falling Star Sect is just to test how far behind he is compared with the high-level cultivators of the Bone Forging Realm.
However, judging from the previous fight, once Tang Tian mastered the Nine-turn Heavenly Thunder Technique and was instantly promoted to the high level of the Burning Blood Realm, his combat effectiveness would increase several times.
When the time comes, he will be sure of success in a battle with Lin Yichen, who is an inner disciple.
The two Luo Xing Sect disciples had no idea what Tang Tian was thinking. They wanted to kill this kid anxiously so that they could help deal with Ye Ruxue.
Although Tang Tian could only use his physical power, it was not easy to deal with, especially in close combat, his explosive power was simply terrifying.
Although their cultivation was strong, their bodies were very fragile. If they were not careful, they might be blown away by Tang Tian's punch.
At this moment, a scream sounded in the forest.
It turned out that it was the tall and thin young man who would lose if he stayed for a long time, and his chest had been pierced by the long sword in Ye Ruxue's hand.
"No, senior brother is dead, let's leave quickly!"
The two people who originally besieged Tang Tian were frightened out of their wits.
Are you kidding me, if it's one-on-one, only they will die.
"You want to leave now? It's too late!"
Tang Tian sneered, taking advantage of one of them being flustered, he got close and punched out.
"Click..."
One punch broke several ribs on the man's chest.
Tang Tian grabbed the long sword from the opponent's hand and rushed past him, the blade of the sword grazing the opponent's neck.
The body fell down, leaving only another man whose legs were weak as he tried to escape.
Tang Tian stood in front of him, and Ye Ruxue stood behind him. The pressure was too great.
Although Ye Ruxue was powerful, the pressure Tang Tian put on the other party was even greater.
It was true that Tang Tian was ruthless and cruel in his attacks, which had already left an indelible shadow on the Luo Xing Sect disciple.
"Plop"
With a sound, the man knelt down on the ground and said tremblingly: "Please...please spare my life.
Everything that happened today, I will definitely keep secret...I..."
"I'm sorry, but I don't like to hear nonsense!"
The long sword in Tang Tian's hand pierced the opponent's chest like a bolt of lightning.
"You..."
It was only when he died that this Luo Xing Sect disciple realized that everyone had underestimated Tang Tian.
Tang Tian was not only wretched, but also crazy, ruthless and merciless...
If they had known this would happen, they would not have been willing to provoke a cultivator at the beginning of the Burning Blood Realm.
But then again, how could any high-level cultivator in the Bone Forging Realm take a low-level cultivator in the Burning Blood Realm seriously?
Even high-level Burning Blood Realm people are just ants in their eyes.
Tang Tian looked up and saw Ye Ruxue looking at him.
Tang Tian was a little embarrassed to be looked at by such a stunning beauty. Could it be that he was too handsome?
I have completely forgotten how he looks like a ragged beggar now, how can he be associated with the word handsome?
Tang Tian didn't speak, but Ye Ruxue took the initiative to speak, saluted and said, "Thank you, young master, for saving me."
It can be said that four of the five people just died in Tang Tian's hands. It must be said that this time the hero saved the beauty very successfully.
